ConnectionStrings.Aspire_Comment: Running Bit.Fabric.Server.AppHost `overrides` the following connection strings at runtime.
ConnectionStrings.redis-cache_Comment: Redis for FusionCache L2 distributed cache layer and SignalR backplane - no persistence needed, acts as fast ephemeral cache
ConnectionStrings.redis-persistent_Comment: Redis for Hangfire background jobs and distributed locking - requires persistence for durability
ConnectionStrings.smtp_Comment: You can also use https://ethereal.email/create for testing purposes.
ConnectionStrings.ConnectionStrings_Comment: The ConnectionStrings section contains database connection strings used by the application.

Reasoning.Effort_Comment: None | Low | Medium | High | ExtraHigh. Higher effort adds latency and output tokens. None for a provider with only /v1/chat/completions (See AI:OpenAI:ChatUseResponsesApi).
Reasoning.Output_Comment: None | Summary | Full. Summary shows the chat panel what the model reasoned.

AI.ChatOptions_Comment: Configures Temperature, TopP, TopK and the rest of the properties of Microsoft.Extensions.AI.ChatOptions. Temperature null leaves the model its own default: a reasoning model refuses any other, so set a number only while Reasoning:Effort is None.

OpenAI.ChatUseResponsesApi_Comment: /v1/responses, where the model can call tools while it reasons. false for a provider with only /v1/chat/completions, such as Google AI Studio, and then set AI:ChatOptions:Reasoning:Effort to None.
OpenAI.ChatApiKey_Comment: Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys - or point ChatEndpoint at any OpenAI compatible provider and use its key.
OpenAI.ChatEndpoint__Samples: Google AI Studio: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai | Open Router: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
OpenAI.TextToSpeechVoice_Comment: Get a list of voices at https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech#voice-options
OpenAI.RealtimeApiKey_Comment: Enables voice calls in the AI chat panel. The key stays on the server.
OpenAI.RealtimeReasoningEffort_Comment: minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh. Empty keeps OpenAI's default, which is low for gpt-realtime-2 and 2.1. Higher effort adds latency and output tokens.
OpenAI.OpenAI_Comment: Chat, embedding and speech are separate deployments: each might carry its own model, endpoint and key.

Identity.BearerTokenExpiration_Comment: BearerTokenExpiration used as JWT's expiration claim, access token's expires in and cookie's max age. Format: D.HH:mm:ss
Identity.UnconfirmedUsersRetention_Comment: How long an unconfirmed account that has never signed in is kept before it is deleted. Format: D.HH:mm:ss.
Identity.MaxPrivilegedSessionsCount_Comment: Is the maximum number of concurrent privileged sessions a user can have.

Email_Comment: You can also use https://ethereal.email/create for testing purposes.
Sms_Comment: Sent through SmsBridge (https://github.com/teesofttech/SMSBridge). For Vonage, Sinch, Plivo, Telnyx, MessageBird, AWS SNS, Infobip and more, add the provider here with its Type, point DefaultProvider at it and make SmsOptions.Configured in ServerApiSettings.cs check its settings.
AiChatImagesRetention_Comment: How long an image attached to an AI chat message is kept before it and its blob are deleted. Format: D.HH:mm:ss.

AdsPushVapid.AdsPushVapid_Comment: Web push's VAPID key pair. Create one with `bit keys vapid`.
AdsPushVapid.Subject: mailto:you@example.com

AdsPushAPNS.P8PrivateKey_Comment: p8 certificate string without any space and start and end (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- and -----END PRIVATE KEY-----) tags.
AdsPushAPNS.P8PrivateKeyId_Comment: 10-digit p8 certificate id; often part of a downloaded certificate filename
AdsPushAPNS.TeamId_Comment: 10-digit Apple team id shown on the Apple Developer Membership Page
AdsPushAPNS.EnvironmentType_Comment: Apns Env one of Development or Production

Hangfire.UseIsolatedStorage_Comment: Useful for testing or in production when managing multiple codebases with a single database.
Hangfire.JobExpiration_Comment: How long a finished job and its arguments are kept. Quoted in the privacy notice, so change both together.

Twitter.ConsumerSecret_Comment: Also known as API Key Secret

Apple.ClientId_Comment: Your Service Id's Identifier such as com.adminpanel.bitplatform.dev
Apple.TeamId_Comment: 10-digit Apple team id shown on the Apple Developer Membership Page
Apple.AppleAuthKey.p8_Comment: Download .p8 file and save it with AppleAuthKey.p8 name in bin directory

Keycloak.Keycloak_Comment: The base URL of your Keycloak server, e.g., https://keycloak.yourdomain.com/ or http://localhost:8080/

Authentication.Keycloak_Comment: Configure your Keycloak OpenId Connect configuration

TrustedOrigins_Comment: The origins this app trusts: its own address, which links in emails point to, plus the origins allowed for CORS, return URLs after external sign-in and email confirmation, and WebAuthn. List the app's own address here unless `WebAppUrl` is set, since the Host header is the client's to write and any address not listed gets a 400.

ForwardedHeaders.ForwardedHeaders_Comment: These values apply only if your backend is hosted behind a CDN (such as `Cloudflare`).
ForwardedHeaders.ForwardedHostHeaderName_Comment: For Cloudflare, use X-Host instead of X-Forwarded-Host.
ForwardedHeaders.KnownIPNetworks_Comment: CIDR ranges of the proxies allowed to tell this app who the client is - a request from the public internet can never carry one of these addresses. Loopback covers a proxy on the same host; the ranges above cover one running beside the app, such as a cloudflared tunnel or an Aspire, Docker Compose or Kubernetes sidecar. Behind Cloudflare, use a Cloudflare Tunnel: the origin then needs no inbound port at all - close 80 and 443 to the internet - and the visitor's real ip arrives with the request. On an intranet deployment, where the clients themselves sit in these ranges, empty this out.

Cloudflare.ZoneIds_Comment: The ResponseCacheService purges the edge cache by cache-tag, which covers every hostname of a zone at once. Add more than one zone id only if your app is served from domains belonging to different Cloudflare zones.

Monitoring.NetworkSecret_Comment: Shared with the bitplatform Network (src/Network), which reads the projects it times and posts its readings with it in the X-Network-Secret header. Empty turns those endpoints off, so projects are checked from Germany alone. A deployment sets it from the GitHub environment's SERVERAPI__MONITORING__NETWORKSECRET secret, which bitfabric-internal/.github/workflows/cd-network.yml gives the Network as well.
Monitoring.NetworkTargetsPerLocation_Comment: How many projects one location of the Network times a minute, the first added first. 50 keep it within the Workers free plan (src/Network/README.md).
Monitoring.LighthouseUrl_Comment: bit Fabric's Lighthouse service (src/Server/Bit.Fabric.Server.Lighthouse), which runs the performance and accessibility scans. The AppHost sets it, in aspire start and in the published Docker Compose project alike; empty leaves those two scans out.
Monitoring.BrowserScanParallelism_Comment: How many performance and accessibility scans run at once across every instance. The Lighthouse service runs one page at a time, so more only wait there.

DocsMcp.FeedbackEmailAddress_Comment: Where the SendBitPlatformFeedback tool of /docs-mcp emails what an agent reports, through the smtp connection string. Empty leaves the tool refusing, telling the agent to open a GitHub issue instead.

CodeIndex.DataDirectoryPath_Comment: Holds the codebase-memory command line, the sources of every served bit platform release and their index, for the source code tools of /docs-mcp. It must be writable and outlive a deployment: the published Docker Compose project sets it to the api's docs-mcp volume (See DockerComposePublishingExtensions). Empty turns the index off, and the source code tools say so; every other tool answers either way.
CodeIndex.MinimumVersion_Comment: Every stable release at or above it gets an index of its own; ?v= picks one, and the newest answers otherwise.
CodeIndex.CliVersion_Comment: The release of https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp installed into DataDirectoryPath, checked against the checksums published with it.
CodeIndex.CliPath_Comment: An executable to run instead of installing CliVersion, such as a codebase-memory-mcp already on this machine.

HealthChecks.Websites_Comment: Other sites to watch with the app, such as its landing page, blog or docs: https://blog.example.com, or a bare host for https. A site that fails makes /health Degraded, and /healthz says which one and why. In a deployment, set them all as one comma separated value: HealthChecks__Websites.

HubOptions.HubOptions_Comment: Bound onto Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.HubOptions for both the app's own hub and the Blazor Server circuit.
HubOptions.MaximumReceiveMessageSize_Comment: 2MB. The largest messages the hubs carry are a question of the AI chat panel, which goes up with the newest messages of the conversation before it (See AiChatHistoryWindow), and a recording of its microphone handed back from JavaScript over the Blazor Server circuit (See AppAiChat.MaxRecordingSize). A ceiling rather than an expectation - it is what one client can make the server buffer per message.

SupportedAppVersions.MinimumSupportedAppVersion_Comment: A value wins. Empty: a client is supported unless its major version is behind the server's. 0.0.13 (2026-11-17): template 11.0.0-pre-21 renamed the profile image's endpoints and fields and the tenant membership's field, which every client before it uses, so those update first, as the clients before 0.0.10 did for the AI chat's hub (See bitfabric-internal/specs/build-and-ship.md).
